standouts.text: On Nov 27 it dipped and closed near its high, leaving a long lower wick: buyers rejected the lows after a decline.
standouts.learn: A dip the close bought back: a small body over a tall lower shadow.

against.head: Weekly chart: declining
against.text: Price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 in its buy zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Sep 16, 2025 to Jun 30 (+194%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+9.9% to −11%), in three waves, with the Nov 3, 2025 high and the 50% retracement of the Mar 31, 2025–Jun 29 rise in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−37%); a close over the wave-1 high (+86%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the January breakout level, the open gap of Nov 27 and the 20-day average, where 7 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Selling is losing force (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a lower low in price (the week of Nov 2) against a higher low in momentum (6 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 32% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the July high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Next support −2.9% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −2.9% below (0.8 ATR), where 8 levels (5 kinds) meet: the Jul 9 low, the average price paid since the Oct 23 high and the most-traded price of six months.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Sitting on support
material.text: Price sits on the October breakout level, the July breakout level and the November breakout level.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier
material.text: A higher low in price (Nov 23) against a lower low in momentum (6 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.
